nom: L’Oreal Paris Collagen Daily Face Moisturizer

avis.texte: I’ve been using the L’Oréal Paris Collagen Daily Face Moisturizer for a few weeks now, and am surprised how much I like it. The first thing I noticed is how soft it makes my skin feel almost immediately. It’s a thicker cream, but it doesn’t sit heavy or greasy, or have any scent at all. I use it in the morning under makeup without any issues, and at night it feels really comforting, especially if my skin is dry which is all the time! As far as the “collagen” and wrinkle claims go, I wouldn’t say it’s a miracle product. It’s not going to erase lines, but I have noticed my skin looks a bit smoother and more plump, which makes my fine lines way less obvious. I think that’s mostly from how hydrating it is. Also, if you’re expecting serious anti-aging results, this probably isn’t enough on its own. I use it over two serums and with tret. You’d also still want sunscreen before going out. Overall, I’d describe it as a really solid, no-nonsense moisturizer. It’s affordable, reliable, and makes your skin feel good. Definitely worth it if you want simple hydration that actually works.

I wish I’d had this awesome cream years ago as it has done wonders for my face and neck! I’ve tried MANY different brands, but this has been my favorite, and only one for the last two years. My skin instantly feels soft and it makes my foundation look flawless! It’s shockingly inexpensive, yet it feels very high end. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND it!

avis.titre: A review from someone who has tried SO MANY moisturizers!
avis.texte: I have combination skin that gets super oily, but also super dry (especially with retinol use), sensitive, textured, and acne prone. This is my HONEST review of the L'Oreal Collagen Moisturizer. So first of all, the product is reasonably priced but it does come in a pretty small container. It is a thick consistency so a little goes a long way, but it doesn't absorb well enough and leaves my face feeling a bit cakey/heavy/oily. I wouldn't be able to use this as a day cream, because my face would just look too oily and my makeup wouldn't apply well. It moisturizes well, although I was kind of surprised to see that it doesn't say ANYWHERE on the container itself that it's a moisturizer (it just says "moisture filler" which is a little silly and confusing from a marketing standpoint). I don't get breakouts when I use this, but I also don't get any noticeable results from the Collagen claims. I got the scented one because at the time I purchased this there were no unscented options and it is a STRONG lasting smell. The scent is kind of soapy but a bit intense for me... I don't mind using scented products but with this right next to your nose, it can be a tad overwhelming. avis.titre: I used to love this, but new formula kinda sucks
avis.texte: I have used this product for 20 years. I am a product loyalist and have recommended it to more people than I can recount. When people have asked me how, at 57, I look 40, I point them to this. Unfortunately, L'Oreal has changed the product in multiple ways and it is no longer performant IMHO. The first problem is that once the product soaks into my skin, it no longer feels as moisturized. It's still nice going on, but about an hour later, my skin feels dry again. The old formula lasted all day and all night. Secondly, the fragranced version now smells like some sort of sticky watermelon candy — like a Jolly Rancher or something — and literally makes me nauseous, the scent is so overwhelming. I appreciate that there is an unfragranced version, but I actually liked the older, subtle scent that reminded me of Estée Lauder. It is so disappointing that L'Oreal has changed this product after all of this time to something I no longer believe in. I will likely be looking for a new replacement to this product from a different manufacturer.

avis.titre: Moisturizes well but I think it clogs my pores
avis.texte: This is Reese's review of L'Oreal Paris Collagen Moisture Filler facial moisturizer. I had a very hard time deciding how many stars to give this product, because I feel that it moisturizes pretty well, better than a lot of moisturizers, but it seems to clog my pores. So I settled on three stars, even though it moisturizers better than those stars would imply. The moisturizer feels smooth and thick when you apply it, and sinks into your face well. I don't feel my face becoming dry or tight hours later. I usually apply this at night, and wake up to skin feeling good and not over dry, which is exactly what I need. But when I use it, it seems like I see more clogged pores in the days afterwards, and sometimes even a deep cystic pimple. I haven't changed anything else about my face care, so I can only attribute it to this product. Overall I really want to love this product and give it a great review, but I can't since I suspect it may be clogging my pores.

Overall, I really enjoy the texture, scent, and level of hydration. If your skin is sensitive or reactive to fragranced skincare, though, that’s something I would keep in mind.

I’ve been really impressed with this L’Oréal Paris moisturizer! I’ve already gone through two bottles of the serum from this same line this year and even have another one on the way, so I had pretty high expectations, and this definitely delivered. It makes my skin feel incredibly smooth, soft, and well hydrated, and after about a week of using it, my skin already looks a bit more plump and healthy. I especially love the texture. It’s a thicker cream, which I prefer for nighttime, but it still absorbs really well and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy or heavy. One of my favorite things about this is that it comes in a fragrance free version. I have sensitive skin and try to avoid fragranced products, so this is a huge plus for me, and I haven’t had any irritation at all. The ingredients feel gentle but still effective. The value is honestly amazing too. I was able to get this for under $5 with an Amazon coupon, and I’ve gotten the serums from this line through TikTok Shop deals, so for the quality you’re getting, it’s definitely worth it. The size is also great for the price. The only thing to note is that it doesn’t include SPF, so I just make sure to use sunscreen during the day, but it layers really nicely under other products. Overall, I think this is 100% worth the money, especially if you can catch it on sale. I’ve always loved this brand’s makeup, hair care, and skincare, and this moisturizer just adds to that!

avis.titre: Soft, hydrated skin without the fragrance!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the fragrance-free version of this moisturizer and I really like it. It’s super hydrating and leaves my skin feeling soft and a bit more plump when I use it consistently. The texture is on the thicker side, but it absorbs pretty well and doesn’t feel greasy. I also like that it sits nicely under makeup without pilling. Big plus for me is that it’s fragrance-free, so it doesn’t irritate my skin, (I have highly sensitive skin,) or feel overwhelming like some other creams. It might feel a little heavy if you have oily skin, but for normal to dry skin (or colder weather), it works really well. Overall, it’s a great affordable moisturizer…nothing dramatic, but reliable and makes your skin feel healthy. I LOVE this facial moisturizer and I HIGHLY recommend it!

avis.titre: Excellent product at a great price!
avis.texte: I have never really had a skin care routine other than daily washing and occasionally exfoliating but now that I'm in my 40's I have noticed my skin is very dry and dull looking. I am getting wrinkles around my eyes and forehead as well but my main concern was the dry/dull overall appearance. I was skeptical to try this product since it was so inexpensive compared to others however after just 1 use, I was very impressed and now after 2 months I am even more impressed! My skin immediately looked and felt more hydrated, firm and plump/full. My face has more color and looks so much healthier. My face and neck are smoother than I ever remember, even better than after exfoliating! I apply it morning and night. It goes on easily and absorbs quickly. A small dab goes a long ways so the jar does last awhile! (After 2 months I'm almost half way through my 2nd jar). I am applying L'Oreal 1.5% hyaluronic acid eye serum prior to the moisturizer (starting my 2nd week after I started this collagen moisturizer) and the combination has been amazing and my skin is firmer and much finer wrinkle lines (the serum is also a great price and the trial size bottle lasts a long time). This was my first try at an eye and face moisturizer and it's what I am sticking with - I couldnt be happier with the results! Excellent price point and very good value! I highly recommend this collagen moisturizer!
